offerings.name: grok-imagine-video
offerings.price_basis: grok-imagine-video API video generation at 480p; $0.050 per generated second; generated videos include an audio track by default.
offerings.duration: 1–15 seconds; video editing retains the input duration, capped at 8.7 seconds.
offerings.note: Audio is enabled by default; generate_audio=false requests a silent video. Classic model rejects last_frame.

offerings.name: grok-imagine-video
offerings.price_basis: grok-imagine-video API video generation at 720p; $0.050 per generated second; generated videos include an audio track by default.
offerings.duration: 1–15 seconds; video editing retains the input duration, capped at 8.7 seconds.
offerings.note: Audio is enabled by default; generate_audio=false requests a silent video. Classic model rejects last_frame.

offerings.name: grok-imagine-video-1.5
offerings.price_basis: grok-imagine-video-1.5 API video generation at 480p; $0.080 per generated second; generated videos include an audio track by default.
offerings.duration: 1–15 seconds; video editing retains the input duration, capped at 8.7 seconds.
offerings.note: Audio is enabled by default; generate_audio=false requests a silent video. Reference-to-video can use preset voices.

offerings.name: grok-imagine-video-1.5
offerings.price_basis: grok-imagine-video-1.5 API video generation at 720p; $0.080 per generated second; generated videos include an audio track by default.
offerings.duration: 1–15 seconds; video editing retains the input duration, capped at 8.7 seconds.
offerings.note: Reference-to-video is capped at 720p. Audio is enabled by default and can be disabled with generate_audio=false.

offerings.name: grok-imagine-video-1.5
offerings.price_basis: grok-imagine-video-1.5 text-to-video or image-to-video at native 1080p; $0.080 per generated second; generated videos include an audio track by default.
offerings.note: 1080p is supported for text-to-video and image-to-video only. Audio is enabled by default; generate_audio=false requests silence.
